name: Mastocytosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Diagnostic Criteria for Systemic Mastocytosis

criteria.description: Multifocal, dense infiltrates of mast cells (≥15 mast cells in aggregates) detected in bone marrow biopsies or other extracutaneous organs
More than 25% of mast cells in infiltrate are atypical or spindle-shaped in bone marrow or other extracutaneous organs
Detection of KIT codon 816 mutation in bone marrow, blood, or other extracutaneous organs
Mast cells in bone marrow or blood expressing CD2 and/or CD25 in addition to normal mast cell markers
Serum total tryptase persistently >20 ng/mL (unless associated with an associated clonal myeloid disorder)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Diagnosis requires either the major criterion and one minor criterion, or at least three minor criteria.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Criteria are primarily for systemic mastocytosis; cutaneous mastocytosis diagnosis relies on clinical and histopathological findings.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Darier's sign (urtication and erythema upon skin rubbing)
searchTerms: skin redness and swelling after rubbing
red hive-like reaction on skin rubbing

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cutaneous mast cell infiltrates presenting as urticaria pigmentosa
searchTerms: skin spots from mast cell buildup
brownish skin lesions with mast cells

common.symptomName: Flushing episodes due to mast cell mediator release
Pruritus (itching) related to mast cell degranulation
searchTerms: itching caused by allergic cell activation

common.symptomName: Anaphylaxis triggered by allergens or physical stimuli
searchTerms: anaphylaxis caused by allergens or physical factors

common.symptomName: Bone pain due to mast cell infiltration or osteoporosis
searchTerms: bone pain from mast cell disease
aching bones due to bone loss
painful bones from infiltration or osteoporosis
episodes of low blood pressure not from allergy
drops in blood pressure unrelated to anaphylaxis

rare.symptomName: Pathologic fractures due to severe bone involvement
Neuropathy related to mast cell infiltration
searchTerms: nerve damage from mast cell infiltration
neuropathy symptoms due to mast cells
nerve problems linked to mast cell disease

rare.symptomName: Cardiac arrhythmias secondary to mast cell mediator effects
searchTerms: irregular heartbeats from mast cell effects
heart rhythm problems related to mast cells

rare.symptomName: Severe anaphylactic shock with cardiovascular collapse
searchTerms: severe allergic shock with heart collapse

imaging: Bone densitometry showing osteoporosis or osteosclerosis
CT or MRI showing organomegaly (liver, spleen, lymph nodes)
genetic: Somatic KIT gene mutation at codon 816 (D816V)
other: Bone marrow biopsy showing multifocal dense mast cell infiltrates
Positive Darier's sign on skin examination

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of mast cell infiltrates in biopsy
Transient symptoms without persistent mast cell proliferation
Normal serum tryptase levels outside acute episodes
No skin lesions typical of mastocytosis

references: Valent P, Akin C, Metcalfe DD. Mastocytosis: 2016 updated WHO classification and novel emerging treatment concepts. Blood. 2017;129(11):1420-1427.
Castells M. Mastocytosis: a disease of mast cells. Immunol Allergy Clin North Am. 2014;34(3):407-425.
